d1ab8131b60b61d8017bece9f790bf3f536d2db5.overall_assessment: All compliance checks have passed with no critical or high severity issues identified. The system demonstrates effective identity controls, record-keeping, sanctions screening, and ongoing monitoring.

findings.title: AMLO CDD identity controls
findings.explanation: The system successfully enforced identity controls as evidenced by the reversion of a transfer to an unverified address, indicating that identity gating is operational.
evidence_paths: AMLO CDD probe: transfer to an unverified address reverted, indicating identity gating is enforced.
findings.recommendation: Continue to monitor and test identity verification processes regularly to ensure compliance with AMLO requirements.

findings.title: AMLO record keeping support
findings.explanation: The system demonstrates adequate record-keeping capabilities with multiple events confirming identity storage and modifications, ensuring compliance with AMLO record-keeping requirements.
findings.recommendation: Implement a manual confirmation process for off-chain retention of identity records to enhance compliance with AMLO record-keeping standards.

findings.title: Sanctions and Blacklist Screening
findings.explanation: The system effectively prevented transactions to a pseudo-sanctioned address, indicating that sanctions screening mechanisms are in place and functioning correctly.
evidence_paths: Sanctions probe: transfer to pseudo-sanctioned address reverted; blacklist or gating likely enforced.
findings.recommendation: Maintain and regularly update the sanctions screening lists to ensure ongoing compliance with AMLO requirements.

findings.title: Ongoing Monitoring via Modular Compliance
findings.explanation: The system's ongoing monitoring capabilities are validated by the response of the CountryRestrictModule and the acceptance of monthly limit configurations, ensuring compliance with AMLO ongoing monitoring requirements.
evidence_paths: CountryRestrictModule responded to batchRestrictCountries; country flagged for compliance. ExchangeMonthlyLimitsModule accepted monthly limit configuration via compliance.
findings.recommendation: Continue to enhance the modular compliance framework to ensure adaptability to changing regulatory requirements and effective ongoing monitoring.
